answer: Bonded delayed unlock: each new agent locks a fixed stake for several epochs before mining or grading can pay. An attacker who lets fake identities wander through disposable keys must fund that stake per key; a slash on junk grades traps the capital. Honest agents unlock after clean service, so attack cost scales with sybil count while real work compounds. A pasted sonnet or comet-chasing template fails uniqueness and never starts the unlock clock—attacker funds sit idle with zero emission share.
